avSummary: play 10, laugh 10, rejoice 3, scorn 3, sport 3, merry 2, mock 2, deride 1, derision 1, mockers 1
definition:
1) to laugh, play, mock
    1a) (Qal)
        1a1) to laugh (usually in contempt or derision)
        1a2) to sport, play
    1b) (Piel)
        1b1) to make sport
        1b2) to jest
        1b3) to play (including instrumental music, singing, dancing)
    1c) (Hiphil) to laugh mockingly
